meta.name: Hearts
meta.author: faluciano
meta.description: Trick-taking avoidance game: follow suit, dodge hearts and the Queen of Spades, or shoot the moon. Lowest score when someone reaches 100 wins

actions.name: play_card
actions.label: Play Card
actions.condition: played_card_index == -1 || if(trick_card_count("trick") == 0, if(get_var("tricks_played") == 0, card_rank_name(current_player.hand, played_card_index) == "2" && card_suit(current_player.hand, played_card_index) == "clubs", card_suit(current_player.hand, played_card_index) != "hearts" || get_var("hearts_broken") == 1 || count_cards_by_suit(current_player.hand, "hearts") == card_count(current_player.hand)), if(has_card_matching_suit(current_player.hand, led_card_suit("trick")), card_suit(current_player.hand, played_card_index) == led_card_suit("trick"), get_var("tricks_played") > 0 || (card_suit(current_player.hand, played_card_index) != "hearts" && !(card_rank_name(current_player.hand, played_card_index) == "Q" && card_suit(current_player.hand, played_card_index) == "spades")) || count_cards_by_suit(current_player.hand, "hearts") + if(has_card_with(current_player.hand, "Q", "spades"), 1, 0) == card_count(current_player.hand)))

scoring.method: if(count_cards_by_suit(current_player.won, "hearts") + if(has_card_with(current_player.won, "Q", "spades"), 13, 0) == 26, 0, if(count_cards_by_suit("won:0", "hearts") + if(has_card_with("won:0", "Q", "spades"), 13, 0) == 26 || count_cards_by_suit("won:1", "hearts") + if(has_card_with("won:1", "Q", "spades"), 13, 0) == 26 || count_cards_by_suit("won:2", "hearts") + if(has_card_with("won:2", "Q", "spades"), 13, 0) == 26 || count_cards_by_suit("won:3", "hearts") + if(has_card_with("won:3", "Q", "spades"), 13, 0) == 26, 26, count_cards_by_suit(current_player.won, "hearts") + if(has_card_with(current_player.won, "Q", "spades"), 13, 0)))
